rules.reasoning: Trigger requires penalty >2%, so exactly 2% does not exceed and below does not exceed.
Trigger requires duration >36 months, so exactly 36 months does not fire.
Trigger fires when spread >=1.5 because 'or more' includes the boundary.
Pass condition fails when spread reaches 2.25 because '2.25 or more' includes the boundary.
De-minimis requires both revenue <10M and income <1M; equality on either fails the trigger; below=(9.9,0.9) fires, at=(10.0,0.9) and above=(9.9,1.0) pass.
Safe harbour condition is ETR >=16%, so exactly 16% qualifies.
Tier 1 floor requires ratio >=50%, so exactly 50% meets the threshold.
Significant incident triggers when users >= threshold, so boundary is inclusive.

weakest_point: Rule 5: the de-minimis rule uses two separate 'less than' thresholds; the provided inputs are not a simple below/at/above series, making the assignment of verdicts to those labels less certain.
